summary:
Iteration 5 — Experience Builder feature-flag gating. Frontend-only tests at 390x844 against public preview, with flags flipped via PUT /api/admin/config (admin bearer token) because the RN-Web Switch still ignores synthetic events. ALL six scenarios A–F pass. Final /api/config/public restored to experience_builder=true AND experience_profiles=true (verified via GET). No React Native red screens. No deprecated packages detected.

A) FLAG OFF — original 4-step flow restored. /create fresh load: create-who-screen rendered, create-who-loading disappeared within ~4 polls (~200ms), header reads '1/4', experience-profile-row still present (profiles stays ON), surprise-me-toggle/party-size-card/builder-quick-row ABSENT. who-option-partner → who-continue-button → create-vibe-screen with header '2/4' and NO interests-disclose. vibe-option-romantic → vibe-continue-button → create-budget-screen header '3/4', NO budget-amount-card, NO budget-quick-row. budget-option-25-50 → budget-continue-button → create-distance-screen header '4/4', distance-option-10 selected, 'Austin, TX' entered and Set resolved location-label='Austin'. CTA text exactly 'Find My Sparks ✨' (NOT 'Continue'). Tap routed to /create/results showing results-loading with 'Designing your moment…' and header 'Your Sparks ✨' with '$25-$50 • 10 miles • Austin'. create-when-screen was NEVER rendered during the OFF flow.

B) FLAG OFF Friends — profile-friends tapped via scrollIntoView + synthetic PointerEvent on /create: party-size-card, surprise-me-toggle, builder-quick-row all remained ABSENT (confirmed).

C) FLAG ON — builder 5-step flow restored. Fresh /create load: header '1/5', surprise-me-toggle present. profile-friends tap → party-size-card appears with party-size-value='4'. who-option-friends → Continue → vibe header '2/5' with interests-disclose present → pick vibe-option-* → Continue → budget header '3/5' with budget-amount-card; budget-quick-150 → budget-amount-input value='150' → Continue → distance header '4/5', distance-option-10 + 'Austin, TX' resolved; CTA text exactly 'Continue' → tap → create-when-screen rendered (when-header '5/5') with when-date-row, duration-row, transport-row all present. when-find-sparks-button → /create/results with results-loading, 'Your Sparks ✨' header, and summary containing '$150'.

D) NO-FLASH check (FLAG OFF): DOM polled every 50ms from navigation until create-who-screen visible + ~1s afterwards. surprise-me-toggle, builder-quick-row, party-size-card NEVER appeared in the DOM at any poll (all three stayed False). The only intermediate state was briefly create-who-loading (gone within ~200ms).

E) Loading placeholder: with both flag ON and OFF, create-who-loading disappeared quickly (<5s, actually ~200ms) and create-who-screen rendered successfully in both passes.

F) Regression: Home (/), My Sparks (/sparks), Profile (/profile) all loaded without red-screen errors. Admin login via Profile → Log In using auth-email-input / auth-password-input / auth-submit-button succeeded for admin@datespark.app. /admin renders admin-screen plus admin-flag-experience-builder and admin-flag-experience-profiles switches (both visible in DOM).

FINAL: PUT experience_builder=true confirmed; GET /api/config/public returns experience_builder=true AND experience_profiles=true.
critical_code_review_comments: features.ts now returns {ready, profiles, builder} with `ready` gated on config query success/error; each wizard screen correctly renders <FeaturesLoading testID='create-<step>-loading'/> before deciding which experience UI to show. Verified NO flash of builder UI on cold-load with flag OFF — the previous 'defaults ON before config loads' concern from iteration 4 is resolved.
WhoStep (app/(tabs)/create.tsx:80) correctly swaps StepHeader total between 4 and 5 based on builderEnabled. Verified header shows '1/4' when OFF and '1/5' when ON.

distance.tsx CTA label branches on `builder` ('Continue' vs 'Find My Sparks ✨') and router.push target branches between /create/when and /create/results. Verified both branches route correctly and the when screen is never reachable with the flag OFF.

budget.tsx wraps StickyFooter in `KeyboardStickyView` only when `builder` is true (via `const Footer = builder ? KeyboardStickyView : React.Fragment`). This causes a minor visual regression when flag is OFF (footer is NOT keyboard-sticky), but TextInput only exists in builder mode, so the keyboard rarely shows on budget step when OFF — low priority.

RN-Web Switch (admin-flag-experience-builder / admin-flag-experience-profiles) still does not react to Playwright synthetic events — ADMIN FLAG TOGGLING THROUGH THE UI REMAINS UNVERIFIABLE in web preview. Direct PUT /api/admin/config is required. Recommend adding a Pressable wrapper around the Switch with its own testID that proxies onValueChange, so tests can flip flags through the UI.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 scenarios pass — A flag-OFF original flow, B flag-OFF Friends, C flag-ON builder flow, D no-flash guarantee, E loading placeholder resolves, F tab + admin regression

seed_data_creation: None. Only pre-seeded admin used. Feature flags were toggled OFF then restored to ON via PUT /api/admin/config.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://vibe-finder-75.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin: admin@datespark.app / SparkAdmin2026!. Preferred way to toggle feature flags in tests is PUT /api/admin/config with Bearer token (RN-Web Switch ignores synthetic PointerEvents). After each test session MUST restore experience_builder=true and experience_profiles=true via PUT and verify with GET /api/config/public. Viewport 390x844. Profile chips beyond ~3.5 need el.scrollIntoView() + synthetic PointerEvent(pointerdown/pointerup/click) — used again this iteration for profile-friends and profile-couple. LLM generation on /create/results still takes 30–60s so results-loading screen + header text are the assertion target (do not wait for spark-card-0). The useFeatures() `ready` gate correctly prevents flash — verified by 50ms DOM polling.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature-flag gating works to spec in both branches, no flash of builder UI on cold load, loading placeholders dismiss promptly, and all step headers / CTA labels / navigation targets switch correctly based on the flag.
